description: An experiment varying two factors at once cannot attribute the effect to either.

inputs.label: Experiment E4
inputs.content:
H1: Adding street-level humidity readings improves urban heat prediction.

E4 compares:
  Condition A: our model with humidity readings, trained on 40 sensor stations
  Condition B: baseline model without humidity readings, trained on 10 stations

Result: A reaches 2.1 C mean absolute error, B reaches 2.9 C. We conclude that
humidity readings improve urban heat prediction.

signals.name: identifies that two factors vary together
